{{Conjecture|legends}}
While they were on the graveyard world of [[Necropolis (Core Worlds)|Necropolis]], the humans [[Zak Arranda/Legends|Zak]] and [[Tash Arranda/Legends|Tash Arranda]] and their adoptive uncle [[Mammon Hoole]] stayed in a '''hostel'''. [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] was in the hostel’s lobby when they arrived, as he asked the other guests and staff if they knew the location of Doctor [[Cornelius Evazan/Legends|Cornelius Evazan]], before leaving when he was not given the information he wanted.<ref name="GOF">''[[Galaxy of Fear: City of the Dead]]''</ref>

Food was served in the hostel, with Zak’s friend, [[Kairn]], leaving a portion aside as a mark of respect for the dead, although he did this more as it was a tradition than because he truly believed in the [[Curse of Sycorax]]. Later, Zak was awoken in his room the hostel by [[Kairn]], who threw stones at his room’s window. Boba Fett also later met with Hoole in the hostel to discuss a job proposition, but Fett later rejected the offer. The hostel’s room’s were equipped with advanced comm link units to allow guests to communicate with people elsewhere. When Zak was later kidnapped by Doctor Evazan, Hoole informed the hostel’s owner, who alerted the local authorities.<ref name="GOF" />
